Resolutions of 2021

57 resolutions, 84% unanimous. From Libya to Syria.

  • 2561 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) until 31 July 2021
  • 2562 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Security Council Resolution 1591 (2005) on the Sudan until 12 Mar. 2022
  • 2563 (2021) Authorization to the Member States of the African Union to maintain the deployment of the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM) until 14 Mar. 2021
  • 2564 (2021) Renewal of sanctions against Yemen imposed by Security Council resolution 2140 (2014) and extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts until 28 Mar. 2022
  • 2565 (2021) International cooperation to facilitate equitable and affordable access to COVID-19 vaccines in conflict areas
  • 2566 (2021) Increase of military and police personnel for the UN Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in the Central African Republic (MINUSCA)
  • 2567 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) until 15 Mar. 2022
  • 2568 (2021) Authorization to the Member States of the African Union to maintain the deployment of the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM) until 31 Dec. 2021
  • 2569 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Security Council Resolution 1874 (2009) concerning the Democratic People's Republic of Korea until 30 Apr. 2022
  • 2570 (2021) Composition and operational aspects of the ceasefire monitoring component of the UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL)
  • 2571 (2021) Extension of the authorizations provided by and the measures imposed by Security Council resolution 2146 (2014) and extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts concerning Libya until 15 Aug. 2022
  • 2572 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the Security Council Committee Established pursuant to Resolution 1540 (2004) concerning Non-Proliferation of Nuclear, Chemical and Biological Weapons until 28 Feb. 2022

  • 2574 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 Oct. 2021

  • 2576 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) until 27 May 2022

  • 2578 (2021) Extension of the authorizations on the inspection of vessels on the high seas off the coast of Libya for a period of 12 months
  • 2579 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS) until 3 June 2022

  • 2611 (2021) Extension of measures imposed by Security Council resolution 2255 (2015) and extension of the mandate of the Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team for a period of 12 months
  • 2612 (2021) Extension of the mandate of the UN Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) until 20 Dec. 2022
